title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A guard that guarded a missing folder
summary: No behaviour changes. The guard added last release named a folder that does not exist, and left the four scripts that run on every publish unguarded.

highlights.title: The Release Tooling Is Guarded
highlights.description: The scan now reads `.github/scripts` in place of a folder that was never there. A hidden byte in the tooling that decides whether a release goes out would have been as invisible as one in a provider.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Last release's glob fix was measured rather than trusted: of 5 093 sources it excludes exactly one more file, the one it was written for, and loses none.
Three audits found nothing: every declared setting is read, every declared command resolves in both builds, and each guard in the path exclusion helper is covered.
